messages.text:
It has 2 comments, but when i clicked it direct to latest comment that i was commented.

What if i'd like to go to first comment ? how ?

Today there is no way from that badge, so here is the workaround, and the fix is assigned.

- Workaround: open the Threads page and pick the older thread from the list. The two comments on this row are T-135 and T-136.
- Cause: the badge links only to the newest comment.
- Fix (incident I-156, small): the badge opens a short list of its comments. The status-board toolsmith (ts-board) has it.
- I will post here when it is live.

What you need to do: nothing.

The comment badge fix is live. An item with 2 or more comment threads now links to all of them, not only the newest.

- Click the badge on the item and pick the thread you want, including the first one.
- Reload the page first so you get the new version.

What you need to do: try it on an item with 2 comments and tell me if the first thread opens.
